title: Government wanted as many crashes as possible to harvest technology

tellings.quote: messed up? Well, there's I heard accounts saying that the government wanted as many crashes as possible so they could harvest as much technology.

plain: John Brandenburg, a scientist, says he has heard accounts about the US government during the Cold War. According to those accounts, the government wanted as many unknown craft to crash as possible so it could harvest as much of their technology as it could.
